description:
Configuration schema for Convex project settings.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/config/convex.json

authKitConfigureSettings.description:
WorkOS AuthKit environment configuration settings.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/auth/authkit/auto-provision

redirectUris.description: Allowed redirect URIs configured in WorkOS.

appHomepageUrl.description: Application homepage URL configured in WorkOS.

corsOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins configured in WorkOS.

authKitConfigure.description: If false, disables automatic configuration of the WorkOS environment. Otherwise configures the WorkOS environment with these settings.

authKitLocalEnvVars.description: If false, disables automatically writing local environment variables. Otherwise writes the given mapping to the local .env file.

localEnvVars.description: Preview deployments must configure environment variables directly in the deployment platform; only `false` is allowed here.

environmentType.description: WorkOS environment type. Only supported in the `prod` section.

localEnvVars.description: Prod deployments must configure environment variables directly in the deployment platform; only `false` is allowed here.

node.description: Node.js specific configuration for server-side packages and dependencies.

externalPackages.description:
List of packages that should be installed on the server instead of being bundled. Use this for packages that can't be bundled or need to be installed directly on the server.

If you want to mark all dependencies as external, you can use the string '*' instead of an array.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/functions/bundling#external-packages

nodeVersion.description:
The Node.js version to use for Node.js actions. The currently supported values are '22' and '24'.

After you push a new Node.js version, your functions may keep running on the previous version for a few minutes.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/config/convex.json#configuring-the-nodejs-version

generateCommonJSApi.description:
When true, generates CommonJS-compatible API files for projects not using ES modules. Enable this if your project uses require() syntax instead of ES modules.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/client/javascript/node#javascript-with-commonjs-require-syntax

functions.description:
Path to the directory containing Convex functions. You can customize this to use a different location than the default 'convex/' directory.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/config/convex.json#changing-the-convex-folder-name-or-location

fileType.description:
The file format of generated code. "ts" generates combined .ts files (recommended for TypeScript projects), "js/dts" generates separate .js and .d.ts files.

Note: "js/dts" must be used when using generateCommonJSApi.

legacyComponentApi.description: When true, generates inline expanded types for component APIs. When false (recommended), generates import-based component API references instead.

staticApi.description:
When true, generates static `api.d.ts` files, which improves autocomplete and incremental typechecking performance in large codebases.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/config/convex.json#using-static-code-generation-beta

staticDataModel.description:
When true, generates static `dataModel.d.ts` files, which improves autocomplete and incremental typechecking performance in large codebases.

Documentation: https://docs.convex.dev/config/convex.json#using-static-code-generation-beta

bundler.description: Configuration for module bundling and source map generation.

includeSourcesContent.description: Whether to include original source code in source maps. Set to false to reduce bundle size.

typescriptCompiler.description: Deprecated. Set to `tsgo` to use the TypeScript Native Preview compiler (`@typescript/native-preview`). TypeScript 7 uses the native compiler without needing this setting to be set.

aiFiles.description: User-configurable settings for Convex AI files behavior.

enabled.description: When false, disables all Convex AI files prompts and staleness messages in `npx convex dev`. Use `npx convex ai-files enable` to re-enable.

skills.description: Configuration for agent skills installed by Convex.

agents.description: List of agents to install skills for (e.g. 'claude-code', 'codex', 'cursor'). Defaults to ['claude-code', 'codex']. For a list of supported agents see: https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills?tab=readme-ov-file#supported-agents
